claims.gist: The challenge is choosing which trends matter, not finding them
These five trends will have greatest strategic impact in 2027
AI agents are moving from pilots into business processes
Planning question is how to scope agents, not whether
Set agent permission boundaries and treat agents as identities
Organizations are formalizing ownership of AI risk
Governance will be built into procurement and development
Name an accountable owner and connect governance to existing systems
Organizations have accumulated thousands of unowned pipelines
A growing number are reorganizing data into managed products
Data products make data more reliable for AI
Catalog critical data assets with quality accountability
Attack surfaces continue to grow
Leading organizations invest in detection, containment and recovery
Budgets will move toward response readiness and backup integrity
Energy, carbon and AI demand push workload energy measurement
Efficiency will matter in architecture decisions
Track compute and energy footprint of expensive services now
Map trends to priorities and assign planning owners
Aim for preparedness rather than adopting everything in 2027

thesis: Five 2027 trends: agentic AI, AI governance, data products, resilience-focused security and sustainable computing.
